verdict.rationale: Jina Reader configures each single-URL request through headers such as `x-engine`, `x-wait-for-selector` and `x-preset`. The evidence shows no batch job construct and no way to map different crawl configurations to URL patterns within one job. Sending separate requests with different headers is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
